record_format_note: No record format exists in the repo/CLI yet; this follows the field lists in spec §5.7, §5.8, §5.9 and §9.4 (spec marks them a draft/sketch). Same layout as the take 6 record.

performance.id_note: Local id (folder + tag). NC has no Performance id registry yet.
performance.title: The C major Prelude, harmony only (after Bach, BWV 846): take 5, forward/reverse echo
performance.performed_at_note: From the mtime of the WAV master (America/Los_Angeles, UTC-7). Record built afterwards.
performance.performer_id_note: NC has no system Identity for the engine yet.

performer.name: Astrid, NetComposer Algorithmic Performer (stand-in script on the box, not the netcomposer CLI)

rules_set_by.note: Forward/reverse echo idea and LP sweep requested by Peter in chat; chord matching and take selection are the script's rules.

composition_ref.version_note: Compositions are not versioned yet; the file hash pins the exact text.
composition_ref.music: Johann Sebastian Bach, Prelude in C major, BWV 846, Das Wohltemperierte Klavier I (1722). Public domain.

analysis.credit: Mark Gotham et al., When in Rome corpus

rule_set.name: bach-strikes fwd/rev echo (BWV 846 take 5)

selection.pool: type=chord strike (musicmatter.art v4 local copy, 702 strikes)
selection.match: chord per bar from bars_v5.py (dim7 any enharmonic spelling)
prefer: small register jump (0.6x) and near MIDI 72 (0.4x)
selection.no_match: G7sus4 (bars 26, 30) built by layering Gsus4 + Csus4/G at -3 dB

rule_set.figuration: two strikes per bar (beats 1 and 3; 2nd at -0.72 dB, bar 35 2nd at -5.19 dB). Voice B plays each strike reversed, starting 0.10 s after it and peaking 80 ms before the next strike, 6 dB under voice A, ducked where it would mask the next attack.

crawl_snapshot.crawled_at_note: Read from the local site copy, not crawled live.

known_compromises.what: Layered substitution: G7sus4 = Gsus4 + Csus4/G (no 7sus4 recording)
G pedal under F#dim7 not carried (G is not a chord tone of any dim7 take)
C pedal under Gdom7 not available

hacks_chain.what: voice B = each strike reversed, swelling into the next strike
hacks_chain.level: B bus 6 dB under A bus (RMS)
hacks_chain.masking_guard: B swell kept >= 3 dB under the next attack

hacks_chain.type: synthetic hall, generated in the script (no external IR)

hacks_chain.design: two cascaded TPT state-variable filters (Butterworth Qs), per-sample coefficients
hacks_chain.sweep: 500 Hz -> 20 kHz exponential over 0-60 s, then 20 kHz -> 600 Hz exponential to the end

hacks_chain.method: ffmpeg loudnorm two-pass, linear (applied when encoding the mp3)
